thread:
sofia: FYI — Sunleaf (UK / GB entity) just flagged a billing failure. They receive USD invoices but their AP team requires GBP invoices with local VAT. Payment was rejected by their bank citing currency mismatch. PO SL-443 attached on their side.

mike: Can you paste the invoice id and a screenshot of the payment failure? Also whether this is happening for multiple invoices or just one run.

sofia: Invoice id INV-2026-993. They say this happened for the weekly aggregated invoice (mar-07 run) and once more for an ad-hoc charge. Screenshot: (attached by DM). Quick snippet of the invoice JSON we pulled:

```
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-993",
  "customer": "sunleaf-uk",
  "billed_entity": "sunleaf-uk",
  "currency": "USD",
  "amount": 12450.00,
  "local_currency_expected": "GBP",
  "fx_rate": 0.78123,
  "rounding_policy": "truncate",
  "po_number": "SL-443",
  "po_required": true
}
```

ricardo: :eyes: That JSON looks like the currency field on the invoice is being populated from the top-level account currency instead of the billed_entity currency. I suspect the multi-entity flow mishandles currency override when invoices are consolidated. Quick query to reproduce:

```
SELECT i.id, i.currency, e.currency as entity_currency
FROM invoices i
JOIN entities e on i.billed_entity = e.id
WHERE i.id = 'INV-2026-993';
```

If i.currency != e.currency, that's the bug path.

payments-bot: automated-alert: payment_attempt INV-2026-993 failed — decline_code: currency_mismatch, gateway: stripe-uk, attempt_ts: 1836543205

emma: Sunleaf needs a GBP invoice for their AP team to accept the PO. Short-term: can Finance reissue a local-currency invoice (GBP) and mark INV-2026-993 as replaced? Customer is OK to wait ~48 hours while we reissue.

mike: Repro steps for eng/billing team (short):
1) Create account with account_currency = USD and add a billed entity with entity_currency = GBP
2) Generate aggregated invoice for entity with PO present
3) Observe invoice.currency set to account_currency instead of entity_currency
4) Trigger payment; see gateway decline with currency_mismatch in payment logs

ricardo: I'll open a billing ticket and assign to eng-billing oncall. Priority P1 for reissue flow; seems like a regression after the multi-entity consolidation changes last week. I'll include the query, invoice id, and the failing stripe event id.

sofia: Customer agrees to manual GBP invoice for now. Please escalate — this breaks weekly run for them. :pray: Also adding Sales to confirm if there are other Sunleaf entities impacted.

mike: Noted. I'll coordinate manual reissue and confirm when done. Tagging @ricardo when the ticket is linked.

ricardo: Ticket created: BILL-4621. I'll push a hotfix branch to ensure invoice.currency falls back to entity.currency when entity present. Will post PR link shortly.

sofia: Thanks all — please update this thread with PR and reissue confirmation so I can tell the customer their AP team and bank will accept the new invoice.
